fullContent:
Sarva Jwarahara Loha 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwara Rogadhikara 
 Introduction 
 Sarva Jwarahara Loha is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of herbs and minerals. The main ingredient of this formulation is iron metal. This medicine is known to treat problems related to weakness of liver. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Loha Bhasma – Iron calx 
 Chitraka – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula 
 Vibhitaki – Terminalia bellirica 
 Shunti – Zingiber officinalis 
 Maricha – Piper nigrum 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Vidanga – Embelia ribes 
 Musta – Cyperus rotundus 
 Shreyasi – Scindapsus officinalis 
 Pippalimula – Piper longum 
 Ushira – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 Devadaru – Cedrus deodara 
 Kiratatikta – Swertia chirata 
 Hrivera – Pavonia odorata 
 Katuki – Picrorhiza kurroa 
 Kantakari – Solanum xanthcarpum 
 Shigru – Moringa oleifera 
 Yashti – Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 Kutaja – Holarrhena antidysenterica 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take loha bhsama up to 20 grams and other ingredients up to 10 grams. 
 Powder all the ingredients and mix in the loha bhsama to prepare Sarva Jwarahara Loha. 
 
 Dose 
 250 to 500 mg, one to two times a day, before or after meals, with honey or Giloy decoction. 
 Indications 
 
 Iron deficiency 
 Intermittent fever 
 Chronic fever 
 Liver problems 
 Splenomegaly 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Stomach burning due to over doses. 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
